changelog:
**Major update: Skill now uses Coinbase CDP wallets for fully autonomous and secure agent operations.**

- Wallet operations (signing, on-chain transfers) now use Coinbase CDP, with credentials in a configurable env file.
- New Node.js CLI scripts: check address, request/sign loan, pay/repay.
- Payment skill dependency removed; now requires Node.js and @coinbase/cdp-sdk.
- Usage guides and workflow updated for CDP wallet setup and commands.
- Security improvements: never exposes private keys; recommends agent-dedicated credentials.
- Old skill-card documentation removed; tooling and commands modernized for autonomous agent workflows.
summary: AI-native lending on Base MAINNET for autonomous agents. Check credit, request USDC loans (EIP-712 signed via Coinbase CDP), and repay autonomously. Real money.
